notes: The 2010–2020 median and average neuroinvasive proportion are computed from historic ArboNET data (footnote), so the period comparison is treated as the article's own pair comparison. The estimate of 60,240–140,560 nonneuroinvasive cases applies a cited 30–70 multiplier and is arithmetic.
view_issues: 'Significant WNV outbreak' is colloquial; no tests, p-values or CIs appear. Table 2 CSV Louisiana St. Louis encephalitis cell reads '1 (0.02' (missing parenthesis). Discussion's '57% of all U.S. cases' refers to neuroinvasive cases.
